title: Partying like a local
text:
Here is your sign to book this one of a kind, bar crawl! 
I booked this last minute and had absolutely zero regrets! 
You meet up in Hostel Generator and work your way through some bars and clubs, ones you would never find by yourself! 
The guide was also super friendly, would definitely recommend!
author: Camper16388307956

title: Great night!
text: Nara and Ana were amazing! Had a great night
author: gracegG8445JQ

title: Madrid
text: Dully was a great host. Pub crawl was a sucess. Best pub crawl in Spain. Atmosphere is great, everybody has a great time. They take you to the best bars and clubs.
author: irvingg102

title: Great night!
text: Very good experience, Luigi was a very good host and the pub crawl was so much fun. I met a lot of incredible people and the bars were amazing.
author: jennawH8462MF

title: I think it’s a totally worthwhile experience because you meet so many people from so many countries
text: It was amazing, a great experience. They took us to very cool pubs, the music was very very good. Our guide Lilu was the best, always on the lookout and helped us in any way we needed. The best guide without a doubt!!
author: O1895ILpaulag

title: Praise
text:
Lilu was amazing! Best guide! I had a lot of fun at the pub crawl. Best way to meet new people!

I liked it and I recommend it!
author: igorbI2103QR

title: Laughter and enjoyment
text: The tour was fun from start to finish, Inés made us feel like we had known her all our lives because she was so friendly, fun, and eloquent! We paid a great price and we danced until we couldn't, without a doubt I will recommend The PuwCrawl
author: Ladydecente

title: Really memorable night....
text: Really memorable night. The guide was amazing. Highly recommended. The bars had a great vibe and the nightclub was too good.
author: Akash_C

title: Must do Madrid pub crawl
text: This pub crawl was one of my highlights while staying in Madrid, it was well organised, the host Juan was amazing. The pubs where great, you got few entry and shots. Most of all you felt very safe the whole time 10/10
author: C9852UPjonathanc

title: Well organised
text: The event was well organised considering we had so many participants! Each venue was fantastic and had great cheap drinks. I felt the crew looked out for the participants really well and made sure we where safe and had a fun time.
author: harrisone77
